summary: Implementation plan for Arabic textual notarial page numbering placed directly below the writing of clauses/body on each page. Enforces paragraph-atomic paging: paragraphs are never split mid-sentence; if a paragraph exceeds the page capacity, the entire block moves to the next page, with 'الصفحة {الترتيب بالحروف} ../..' placed cleanly under the page's last block.
